plan.failureSummary: The cached Page.AI replay failed to find the 'Last Name' input field because the survey form rendered a different question set ('Your Name', 'Contact Email', 'Occupation').
observedIndicators: Error occurred during execution of cached replay script '.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js:38:9' in DETERMINISTIC mode.
The cached step attempted to locate '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' / 'Last Name *', but the failure screenshot shows the form contains 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *'.
The overall objective ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...') is semantically flexible and easily adaptable by a fresh autonomous execution.
Browser console and network logs show 0 errors, indicating the application itself is functioning normally.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for tests/unstable-survey.test.ts and re-run the test to allow the autonomous agent to handle the current form layout.

plan.notes: The target application alternates form variants. Clearing the Page.AI cache will allow the autonomous agent to dynamically inspect and fill the active form variant.
